name: FLA_ASSET_IMPAIRMENTS_INT
description: FLA_ASSET_IMPAIRMENTS_INT contains lease asset impairment details.

columns.name: INTERFACE_IMPAIRMENT_ID
columns.description: Interface asset identifier. This column constitutes primary key along with LOAD_REQUEST_ID column of the table.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERFACE_LEASE_ID
columns.description: Interface Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_INT table.

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: Asset number which is either automatically generated or entered by the user, based on the system setup option.

columns.name: PAYMENT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Payment currency code of the payment associated to asset.

columns.name: RECOVERABLE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Recoverable right of use amount.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
